pairs: And the Lord spoke to Moses,
Speak to the sons of Israel,
and you shall say to them:
Homo qui votum fecerit, et spoponderit Deo animam suam, sub æstimatione dabit pretium.
The man who will have made a vow and espoused his soul to God shall give the price according to the estimation.
Si fuerit masculus a vigesimo anno usque ad sexagesimum annum,
If it is a male from twenty years to sixty years,
dabit quinquaginta siclos argenti ad mensuram sanctuarii:
he shall give fifty shekels of silver, by the measure of the Sanctuary;
A quinto autem anno usque ad vigesimum,
But from the fifth year until the twentieth,
a male shall give twenty shekels;
Ab uno mense usque ad annum quintum,
From one month until the fifth year,
for a male, five shekels shall be given;
et ultra masculus dabit quindecim siclos:
a male shall give fifteen shekels;
and he does not have the means to pay the estimation,
he shall stand before the priest,
and however much he will value him
and see that he is able to pay,
Animal autem, quod immolari potest Domino,
But an animal which could be immolated to the Lord,
And if he has exchanged it,
et illud pro quo mutatum est, consecratum erit Domino.
and that for which it was exchanged shall be consecrated to the Lord.
Animal immundum, quod immolari Domino non potest,
An unclean animal which could not be sacrificed to the Lord,
shall be led before the priest,
qui judicans utrum bonum an malum sit,
who, judging whether it is either good or bad,
Quod si dare voluerit is qui offert,
But if he who offers it was willing to give,
he shall add a fifth part above the estimation.
If a man has vowed his house,
and he has sanctified it to the Lord,
considerabit eam sacerdos utrum bona an mala sit,
and it shall be sold according to the price which he will have established.
sin autem ille qui voverat, voluerit redimere eam,
But if he who vowed it was willing to redeem it,
he shall give a fifth part beyond the estimation,
and he shall have the house.
Quod si agrum possessionis suæ voverit,
But if he has vowed a field of his possession,
and has consecrated it to the Lord,
the price shall be estimated according to the measure of the seed.
si triginta modiis hordei seritur terra,
If the land would be sown with thirty measures of barley,
then let it be sold for fifty shekels of silver.
Si statim ab anno incipientis jubilæi voverit agrum,
If he has vowed his field beginning from the current year of Jubilee,
as much as it may be worth,
But if, after some amount of time,
supputabit sacerdos pecuniam juxta annorum, qui reliqui sunt, numerum usque ad jubilæum,
the priest shall evaluate the money according to the number of years that remain until the Jubilee,
then the price shall be reduced.
Quod si voluerit redimere agrum ille qui voverat,
But if he who had vowed it, was willing to redeem his field,
he shall add a fifth part of the money to the estimation,
and then he shall possess it.
But if he is not willing to redeem it,
then it shall be sold to any other;
ultra eum qui voverat redimere non poterit.
he who vowed it is no longer able to redeem it.
For when the day of Jubilee arrives,
it shall be sanctified to the Lord.
et possessio consecrata ad jus pertinet sacerdotum.
And as a possession that has been consecrated, it rightfully belongs to the priest.
If a field has been bought,
et non de possessione majorum sanctificatus fuerit Domino,
and it is not from the possession of ancestors, it shall be sanctified to the Lord.
supputabit sacerdos juxta annorum numerum usque ad jubilæum, pretium:
The priest shall evaluate the price according to the number of years until the Jubilee;
et dabit ille qui voverat eum, Domino.
and the one who had vowed it shall give to the Lord.
In jubilæo autem revertetur ad priorem dominum,
Then, in the Jubilee, it shall be returned to the former owner,
qui vendiderat eum, et habuerat in sorte possessionis suæ.
the one who had sold it and who had held it within the lot of his possession.
All estimation shall be weighed according to the shekel of the Sanctuary.
no one is able to sanctify or vow,
But if it is an unclean animal,
whoever offers it shall redeem it,
and he shall add a fifth part to the price.
If he is not willing to redeem it,
vendetur alteri quantocumque a te fuerit æstimatum.
it shall be sold to another for whatever amount it was estimated by you.
All that is consecrated to the Lord,
neither is it able to be redeemed.
Anything, once it has been consecrated,
shall be the Holy of holies to the Lord.
And all that has been consecrated,
All the tithes of the land,
or from the fruits of trees,
Si quis autem voluerit redimere decimas suas,
But if anyone is willing to redeem his tithes,
he shall add a fifth part to them.
Omnium decimarum bovis et ovis et capræ,
Out of all the tithes of oxen, and sheep, and goats,
which cross under the rod of the shepherd,
every tenth one that arrives shall be sanctified to the Lord.
Non eligetur nec bonum nec malum,
It shall not be chosen by what is good or bad;
neither shall it be exchanged for another.
and that for which it was exchanged,
shall be sanctified to the Lord and shall not be redeemed.
quæ mandavit Dominus Moysi ad filios Israël in monte Sinai.
which the Lord commanded Moses for the sons of Israel on mount Sinai.
